notes.title: Update Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Howdy all!
ːpup3_rːːpup_downː
So we are gearing up to push the improvements we made for the Nintendo Switch version of the game to PC, Mac and Linux.
ːpup_upːːpup_downː
This includes

-New sharper look
-Controller support
-8 new languages, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Japanses, Korean, Russian, Italian and Spanish
ːpup_upːːpup2ːːpup_downː
It should all work pretty well, but to be sure I've put the new build on the beta channel for people to test. I'm expecting the pupdate to launch in about a week, if everything goes well.

ːpup_upːːpup1_rː

-James

notes.title: Version 1.13 Patch Notes
notes.content:
*Added 2 more graphical options and renamed the old one to High (vsync off).
This should help people running the game on lower end machines, as well as people who are running it on a laptop or a device with a battery.
*Made the exit game "X" a little more visible.

ːpup3_rːːpup1_rː

-VideoJames

notes.title: Puzzle Puppers is out!
notes.content:
Everyone here at Cardboard Keep is excited to show off the dogly goodness!
I personally, am excited to get some community feedback on ways that we can improve the game and make it the best experience possible. So feel free to start a thread in the community hub with improvements or questions, I'll be all eyes and ears for the foreseeable future.

-VideoJames
